source.name: HM Land Registry National Polygon Service

checks.claim: National Polygon dataset covers registered freehold and leasehold titles.
Every freehold or leasehold title has at least one index polygon.
Polygons show indicative shape and position of registered-title boundaries.
National Polygon data includes title number.
National Polygon data includes polygon identification.
Update date records when the title changed.
Version of polygon identification number is included.
Index polygons are mapped against Ordnance Survey MasterMap.
National Polygon Service is licensed/chargeable, so it is semantics/reference only for this free-source workflow and not a production numeric source.
